source_checkpoint: df80c9c54590afa9fc0482a4dcb241d21f6b63a3 plus preexisting worktree changes, production hashes in plan.json
method: Saved 16 distinct states cycled to each batch. Preparation and disk load excluded. Both renderers recompute each frame. Five alternating timing samples. Equal image destination. Both CPU single-thread and GPU NVIDIA renderer identity checked.
local_tests: 77 primitive-bound and CPU-component tests passed with the v2 sparse prototype installed.
cpu_conclusion: Per-world/ray compaction reduces intersections and prunes already-blocked shadow rays. At B256 Finger +17.8%, Manipulator +9.0%, BallInCup +1.3%. Entire output remains byte-identical. Finger nearly ties source; Manipulator remains slower. B1 Finger and Manipulator regress. Not a universal replacement.
scene_conclusion: MuJoCo viewport atlas plus one readback per 16 or 64 frames reduces per-frame synchronization. A5000 B256 about +35–37% versus baseline and +32–34% versus source GPU; B1024 +34–37% versus baseline and +29–32% versus source. Tiny viewport-position pixel differences, all measured max per-frame source MSE below 0.0000011. B1 still slower than source.
next_implementation: Prioritize bounded Scene atlas (16 tiles is nearly as fast and has smaller image differences), retaining shadows, MSAA, reflection and transparency. Add supersampling, partial-tile, appearance-group, out-buffer and framebuffer-lifecycle coverage before production. CPU sparse compaction is useful for selected larger batches but insufficient for Manipulator; next structural target is fused CPU intersections and shadow distance-only evaluation, avoiding full tensor temporaries and unused normals.
pending: RTX 3090 job 6851295, gpu/norm-gpu, awaiting resources. Do not promote A5000 results into the 3090 table.
limitations: Only three CPU registrations and Scene GPU were experimentally changed.
Throughput depends on host and batch; compare alternating baseline/candidate on the same host, not different historical runs.
No claim of a universal speedup or completed renderer project.
